summary: SDK-55 ROLLBACK VERIFICATION. Confirmed package.json is fully back to the SDK-55 baseline (expo ^55.0.0, expo-router ~55.0.18, react 19.2.0, react-native 0.83.10, reanimated 4.2.1, gesture-handler ~2.30.0, eslint-config-expo ~55.0.1, typescript ~5.9.2 — identical to iteration_100/101, zero SDK-56-specific versions remain). App boots cleanly end-to-end on web preview with ZERO console/runtime errors: language screen -> consent -> login -> home -> all 4 bottom tabs (Home/Rights/My files/Me) -> Ask tab all render correctly. Backend /api/health and /api/auth/login both 200. Journey create (/api/journey/status) + guardian public status HTML page both work end-to-end. Issue Reporter FAB opens, category select + submit works ('Thank you — your report has been sent.'). SOS/Emergency screen and Evidence Locker PIN screen both load cleanly. HOWEVER: the explicitly-requested 'Full Head Out wizard happy path' is STILL BROKEN at the final step — tapping 'Start journey' throws 'google api is already presented' and crashes the app back to wizard Step 1, losing the in-progress session. This is the exact same critical bug already reported in iteration_104 and is NOT fixed by anything described in this rollback — it's unrelated to the SDK-55/56 version itself (present in the 'kept' DestinationMapPicker.web.tsx / ActiveJourneyMap.web.tsx files, which still independently mount their own <LoadScript> from @react-google-maps/api).

minor.issue: Returns HTTP 502 every time it's called during manual destination typing. Backend log shows: 'geo_autocomplete: OSM-only lookup failed: name 'NominatimFallbackProvider' is not defined' (NameError in geo_router.py — a missing import/undefined class reference). The app fails closed gracefully (manual Search/custom-destination flow still works, per its documented design), so this did not block the wizard, but the autocomplete feature itself is fully non-functional and silently broken server-side.

integration_issues.flow: Head Out wizard Step 3 (circle.tsx) -> tap 'Start journey' (headout-start-journey) -> active /women/head-out session screen
integration_issues.issue: CRITICAL, UNFIXED, PRE-EXISTING (same bug as iteration_104): tapping 'Start journey' throws a runtime error 'google api is already presented' within ~1s. This crashes the component tree; RootErrorBoundary resets the app, and the user lands back on /women/head-out/destination (wizard Step 1) with a blank 'Search a saved place' input — the destination/radius/circle selections made are lost, and the active countdown session is never visibly reached. Reproduced twice with different destination labels (TEST_Connaught Place). RCA unchanged from iteration_104: both src/women/DestinationMapPicker.web.tsx and src/women/ActiveJourneyMap.web.tsx independently mount their own <LoadScript googleMapsApiKey=...> from @react-google-maps/api. That library only supports one LoadScript instance per page lifecycle; when destination.tsx's map instance is still torn down while head-out's ActiveJourneyMap mounts a second one during the Step3->active-session transition, it throws. NOTE: the 'simplified map fallback... replaced with a static placeholder' described in the task handoff does NOT appear to have removed LoadScript from these two files — grep still shows <LoadScript> used in both DestinationMapPicker.web.tsx and ActiveJourneyMap.web.tsx (the Leaflet-specific dangling import was removed, but the dual-LoadScript Google Maps crash is a separate, still-present bug).

action_items: BLOCKING for Head Out wizard happy path: Fix the Google Maps LoadScript double-mount crash. Use @react-google-maps/api's useJsApiLoader hook with ONE shared loader (app-level context/hook) instead of DestinationMapPicker.web.tsx and ActiveJourneyMap.web.tsx each independently rendering <LoadScript>. This is the same unresolved bug from iteration_104 -- confirm it is tracked/prioritized before re-attempting any SDK 56+ hop, since it will resurface identically regardless of SDK version.

Fix backend geo_router.py 'NominatimFallbackProvider is not defined' NameError that makes /api/geo/autocomplete always 502. Low priority since the UI fails closed correctly, but it means the Google-Places-autocomplete-dropdown feature (EXPO_PUBLIC_PLACES_AUTOCOMPLETE_V1=true) is currently 100% non-functional server-side.

SDK-55 rollback itself is verified STABLE for everything else tested: boot, auth, tab nav, SOS, Evidence Locker, Issue Reporter, journey create/guardian backend endpoints. Safe to proceed to SDK 56 attempt as long as the two issues above are tracked separately (pre-existing, not regressions from this rollback).

Not tested due to time/scope: admin-issues status dropdown (page loads and gates behind an admin key I didn't have/guess), Issue Reporter FAB drag-and-persist-position behavior (only tested open/fill/submit, not dragging).
critical_code_review_comments: DestinationMapPicker.web.tsx and ActiveJourneyMap.web.tsx both independently bootstrap @react-google-maps/api's <LoadScript> — structural issue flagged in iteration_104, still unresolved after this rollback session. Any screen transition that renders both within the same lifecycle will keep hitting this crash.
api/geo_router.py references NominatimFallbackProvider without it being defined/imported — confirmed via repeated backend.err.log entries on every autocomplete keystroke.

All used ephemeral/ad-hoc tokens, not persisted to any production-looking collection beyond normal app behavior; no cleanup script run but these are clearly TEST_-prefixed and low-volume.
context_for_next_testing_agent: SDK-55 rollback is CONFIRMED STABLE for all core app flows (boot/auth/navigation/SOS/Evidence Locker/Issue Reporter/backend journey+guardian endpoints) -- package.json versions exactly match iteration_100/101's tested-and-passed SDK-55 baseline with zero SDK-56 residue. The ONE genuine blocker found is the Head Out wizard's final 'Start journey' step crashing from a Google Maps double-<LoadScript>-mount error -- this is NOT new, it's the exact same bug reported in iteration_104, and it is NOT an SDK-version-specific bug (it will reproduce on SDK 55, 56, 57, or 58 equally since it's purely a React component lifecycle / library-usage issue in DestinationMapPicker.web.tsx + ActiveJourneyMap.web.tsx). Main agent should decide whether to fix this now before resuming the SDK-56+ hop, or track it as a separate pre-existing defect. Also flag the backend geo_router.py NameError (NominatimFallbackProvider) for a quick fix since it fully breaks server-side autocomplete.
rca_of_issue: Same RCA as iteration_104, re-confirmed live in this session: app/women/head-out/circle.tsx's 'Start journey' button navigates into head-out.tsx, which mounts ActiveJourneyMap.web.tsx's own <LoadScript googleMapsApiKey=...>, while DestinationMapPicker.web.tsx's own <LoadScript> instance (from the just-left destination.tsx screen) may still be tearing down. @react-google-maps/api only supports one LoadScript instance per page lifecycle and throws 'google api is already presented' when a second one mounts before the first fully unmounts. RootErrorBoundary catches this, resetting the screen back to /women/head-out/destination (losing the in-progress wizard selections). Confirmed unchanged from the prior iteration's finding -- the fixes described as 'kept' in this session (removing dangling Leaflet imports, static placeholder) did not touch the Google Maps LoadScript code path at all, so this specific crash was never addressed.
